title: The normalized smooth trace represents compact-support morphisms uniquely
statement: For a prime ell, a positive-characteristic field k with ell invertible, separated finite-type k-schemes X and Y, a morphism f smooth of pure relative dimension d, a bounded constructible coefficient object M on X identified with the shifted Tate twist, and the tensor unit U on Y, there exists a unique morphism t : Rf_! M -> U such that postcomposition with t gives a bijection Hom(K,M) -> Hom(Rf_! K,U) for every bounded constructible K. This is the normalized finite-diagonal and adic-reconstruction representing-pair step used to construct smoothTrace.

source.place: def-route-smooth-trace, Steps 1--4: finite smooth-purity adjunction, normalized adic reconstruction, and condensed realization of the representing counit

proof.text: Apply the finite smooth-purity adjunction at every positive ell-power coefficient level. The diagonal/deformation map and its counit identify the finite Hom pairing and its quotient transition maps.
Use the normalized integral Tate and unit towers and their derived-limit reconstruction to transport the finite Hom bijections to the completed integral objects, preserving the actual counit maps.

Extend coefficients to the finite-extension-valued condensed ring. The scalar realization is exact on the bounded constructible tests, so the integral representing bijections become the displayed condensed Hom bijections. Full faithfulness of the adjunction Hom equivalence gives uniqueness of the resulting trace.

proof_origin.place: The representing Hom pairing is the strictly smaller geometric input from which the trace definition is constructed.

lean.statement: theorem existsUnique_smoothTrace (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] {k : Type u} [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)] {X Y : Over (Spec (.of k))} [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [QuasiCompact X.hom] [IsSeparated X.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [QuasiCompact Y.hom] [IsSeparated Y.hom] (f : X ⟶ Y) (d : ℕ) (hsm : SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f.left) (M : Dᵇc(X.left)⟦Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ⟧) (hM : M.obj ≅ (shiftFunctor _ (2 * d : ℤ)).obj (tateTwistDerived X.left ℓ d)) (U : Dᵇc(Y.left)⟦Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ⟧) (hU : U = MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorUnit (Dᵇc(Y.left)⟦Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ⟧)) : ∃! t : (boundedConstructibleLowerShriek (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) ℓ f).obj M ⟶ U, ∀ K : Dᵇc(X.left)⟦Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ⟧, Function.Bijective (fun a : K ⟶ M ↦ (boundedConstructibleLowerShriek (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) ℓ f).map a ≫ t)
